rules.source: Law no. 124/2024 On Personal Data Protection (Official Gazette no. 9, 17 Jan 2025 per DLA Piper summary) — https://idp.al/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/Law-no.124-2024-DP.pdf
rules.retrieved_snippet: Art. 1: 'This law sets out rules about protection of individuals in relation to the processing of their personal data.' Art. 2: aim is protection of fundamental human rights and freedoms, in particular the right to personal data protection.

rules.source: Law no. 124/2024 On Personal Data Protection, Art. 29 Notification of a personal data breach — https://idp.al/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/Law-no.124-2024-DP.pdf
rules.retrieved_snippet: Art. 29(1): 'the controller shall as soon as possible, but no later than 72 hours, after having become aware of it, notify the Commissioner' unless the breach is unlikely to endanger rights and freedoms of data subjects.

rules.source: Law no. 124/2024 On Personal Data Protection, Art. 8 (child's consent) — https://idp.al/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/Law-no.124-2024-DP.pdf
rules.retrieved_snippet: Art. 8(6): consent-based processing of minors' data in online delivery of goods or services is legitimate only if the minor is at least 16 years old; under 16, only with parental/custodian consent.
